name: Holdfast Champion
summary: Once per long rest, plant your oath, banner, claim marker, or kin-token. For 1 minute, you and allies within 15 ft cannot be moved against your will while conscious, and your first hit each round against an oath-marked or grudge-marked enemy deals +1d10 damage.
